role: HRV sleep-stage classifier thresholds/weights, baseline replacement thresholds and SD floors, the two sleep fragmentation-index coefficients, history de-dup tolerances, heat-acclimation model constants, and the FeatureFlags kill-switch store (App Group UserDefaults + in-memory cache).
types: SleepClassifierConstants: enum — stage thresholds and composite weights per feature set
BaselineConstants: enum — replacement fractions, SD floors
HistoryConstants: enum — filter debounce and duplicate/artifact tolerances
HeatConstants: enum — WBGT stimulus, EWMA rates, bands, replay lookback
FeatureFlags.Key: enum String — 7 flags, all default true
toplevel: Static let constant namespaces; `import os` mid-file (line 339); FeatureFlags.suiteName = AppConfig.appGroupIdentifier and the cache lock initialised empty.

units.does: Resolves the App Group UserDefaults suite on every access, falling back to .standard if the suite cannot be created.

branches.effect: fallback .standard: flags are read/written in the app's own defaults instead of the App Group, silently.

units.does: Private no-op initializer so the only instance is FeatureFlags.shared.
Returns the compiled-in default for a flag: true for all seven keys.

branches.cond: self is any of the seven cases (exhaustive single case list)
branches.effect: returns true; there is no case that returns false, so every flag defaults on.

units.does: Returns a flag's value under the cache lock: cached value if present, else the stored App Group bool if the key exists, else Key.defaultValue; caches the result.

branches.effect: true: return cached value without touching UserDefaults (later writes to the suite by another process are never seen until relaunch); false: resolve and cache.

branches.cond: no object stored for the key in the suite
branches.effect: true: use defaultValue (true); false: use defaults.bool(forKey:).

units.does: Writes the flag to the App Group defaults and updates the cache. Called from the Settings → Flo provider toggles (AIAssistantSettingsPage.bindingFor).
